Select canonical_smiles, substrate_compound_name, parent_compound_name, met_conversion, pathway_key, organism, enzyme_name
From metabolism
Left Join compound_records on metabolism.substrate_record_id = compound_records.record_id
Left Join molecule_dictionary as substrate on compound_records.molregno = substrate.molregno
Left Join molecule_dictionary as parent on metabolism.metabolism.met_id = parent.molregno
Left Join compound_structures on substrate.molregno = compound_structures.molregno
Left Join target_dictionary on metabolism.target_id = target_dictionary.tid
Filter organism = 'Rattus norvegicus'
Limit 200
